$comment: Copy to your project as .claude/ship-cycle.config.json and edit. This overlay supplies ALL project-specific values; the plugin itself stays generic. Nothing here is required — omit a section to use built-in defaults.

changeNature.$comment: bootCheck: a full-context (eager) load command. Declaring it makes gate G7b required on every non-inert backend change so a framework-wiring break (e.g. a new interface caught by an unchanged @MapperScan) can't pass unit+sliced-IT+review yet fail to boot. Keep it as a standing @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment=NONE) test so most changes pay zero extra cost; expensive full-server boots belong in sc-qa (G9). A selector matching zero tests is a FAIL.

design.$comment: Optional. Feeds sc-design's reuse-before-create gate and sc-review's designer lens: point at the design source of truth so UI changes reuse existing tokens/components instead of reinventing them (bespoke empty states, inlined colors, hand-rolled spinners). Omit to have the designer inventory the repo ad hoc.

audit.$comment: Optional. Used by the à-la-carte sc-audit skill. sourceOfTruth = the authoritative contract; surfaces = the consumers checked against it; modules = domain groupings for the parity matrix. Omit to let sc-audit derive these from changeNature and log that defaults are used.

externalReviewers.$comment: Optional. An out-of-process reviewer — a different model/CLI — that a changeNature[].reviews entry can name to run that lens as an async job. Commands are yours; the kit never hard-codes a vendor. Keep snapshot true so the git-write freeze releases in seconds instead of holding the branch for the whole review.

modelRouting.$comment: Optional. tierMap bridges tier names → real model ids the Task tool accepts; the skill passes model=<resolved> per call. base overrides which tier each role runs at. securityReviewModel pins the model the 'security'/'authz' review lenses use, overriding their tier — set it when your top/high tier resolves to a model that refuses security analysis (such a review silently no-ops); pin the most capable model that WILL do security review, at your highest security-review tier — auth/payment upgrades that lens to top, which the pin also overrides. Omit it to use the tier model. effortMap bridges the kit's effort levels to this host's names (its 'xhigh' may be called 'max'); effort is keyed on the judgment/mechanics axis, not on stage names, and scales with the size tier — see ship-cycle Model routing.

env.$comment: Optional. Cuts per-cycle spin-up cost in continuous runs. reuseDevServer: reuse an already-running dev server for QA instead of booting a fresh one each cycle — a bare port (3000), an object {port, healthPath}, or true to auto-detect. sharedNodeModules: share one dep store across worktrees (pnpm store or linked node_modules) so each doesn't re-install. reuseE2EInstall: reuse one Playwright/e2e install (browser binaries are cached) instead of re-installing per worktree. sharedNodeModules links each worktree into one store: teardown removes the link and lets git delete the worktree — never a recursive delete through the link, which would wipe the shared install. These are speed knobs — the plugin still boots clean when a change needs isolation.
